sections.instructions: State the purpose, central claim, or controlling idea in your own words.
sections.label: What I Understand the Writer to Be Doing

sections.instructions: Point to a specific effective passage or piece of evidence and explain why it works.
sections.label: Strongest Passage / Evidence

sections.instructions: Identify a specific place where the reader needs more explanation, evidence, or connection.
sections.label: Area That Needs Clarification

sections.instructions: Ask a question that could help the writer rethink or develop the draft.
sections.label: Question for the Writer

sections.instructions: Offer concrete next moves rather than only ratings or praise.
sections.label: Actionable Revision Suggestions

sections.instructions: Identify feedback you understand and may act on.
sections.label: Feedback I Find Most Useful

sections.instructions: What feedback do you need clarified before revising?
sections.label: Questions / Clarifications

sections.instructions: Convert feedback into specific changes you intend to make.
sections.label: Revision Plan

sections.instructions: What will you preserve because it is already effective?
sections.label: Author Reflection
